snippet.title: New 3D Space Fleet RTS Game[2027 Relase!]
snippet.description:
3D space fleet battle RTS. [ Tactical Blitz Fleet ]

▼Please wishlist it on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5472110/Tactical_Blitz_Fleet/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=devlog&utm_content=ep01_en


Have you ever wanted to fight a space fleet battle in 3D?

I'm JAG, a solo developer from Japan. Inspired by the fleet battles of Legend of the Galactic Heroes, I'm making Tactical Blitz Fleet, a 3D space fleet battle RTS.
In episode 1, I introduce the game and take on a hard question: in space, where there's up and down as well as front, back, left and right, what happens to formations and tactics?
Does the classic crane wing encirclement still work in space? I test it in the game.

▼A question for you, admirals
If you commanded a fleet in 3D space, what formation would you build?
A pincer that traps the enemy from above and below? A sphere, with ships packed into a ball? Please share your ideas in the comments!

For an indie developer, wishlists are one of the biggest things that keep development going.

▼Chapters
▼Chapters
0:00 Opening
1:00 About me and this series
2:15 Demo 1: The wall of 3D tactics - a flat crane wing fails
4:49 Demo 2: Building a fleet, and the mass system
6:04 Modes and setting - three factions, three doctrines
8:09 Where development stands
9:17 A question for you, admirals
10:36 News (please wishlist!)

▼About the game
Tactical Blitz Fleet - planned for release in 2027
- 3D space fleet battle RTS (real-time tactics)

▼Next time
The central breakthrough, tested in 3D space.

*Footage is from a game in development. Details may change.
*English is not my first language. Thanks for bearing with me!
*Japanese version of this episode: https://youtu.be/W33Y5bgvRxs


#TacticalBlitzFleet #IndieGame #GameDev #RTS
